form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Peters introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs

form.official-title: To amend the CARES Act to establish a Community Capital Investment Program, and for other purposes.

section.text: Section 4003 of the CARES Act (Public Law 116–136) is amended by adding at the end the following:

paragraph.text: The Secretary shall establish a Community Capital Investment Program to support the efforts of community investment institutions to provide loans and forbearance for small businesses, minority-owned businesses, and consumers, especially in low-income and underserved communities, by—

subparagraph.text: providing direct capital investments in community investment institutions; and
providing loans to community investment institutions—

clause.text: that have a loan term of 5 years;
with respect to which no loan payment is required under at least the end of the 180-day period beginning on the date the loan is made, or such longer term as the Secretary may determine appropriate.

paragraph.text: The Secretary shall begin accepting applications for capital investments and loans under the Program not later than the end of the 10-day period beginning on the date of enactment of this subsection.
Any preferred stock or other financial instrument issued to the Secretary in exchange for a capital investment under the Program shall carry a dividend or interest rate that does not exceed—

subparagraph.text: 1 percent, during the 3-year period following the date on which such instrument is issued; and
3 percent, after the 3-year period described under subparagraph (A).

paragraph.text: The restrictions described under subsection (c)(3)(A)(ii) shall apply to capital investments and loans made under this subsection.

In carrying out the Program, the Secretary shall use amounts made available under subsection (b), notwithstanding the limitations on the use of such funds under paragraphs (1) through (4) of such subsection (b).

subparagraph.text: The term community investment institution means—

clause.text: a community development financial institution, as defined in section 103 of the Community Development Banking and Financial Institutions Act of 1994 (12 U.S.C. 4702);
a minority depository institution, as defined in section 308 of the Financial Institutions Reform, Recovery, and Enforcement Act of 1989 (12 U.S.C. 1463 note).

subparagraph.text: The term credit union means a State credit union and Federal credit union, as defined in section 101 of the Federal Credit Union Act (12 U.S.C. 1752).
The term impact credit union means a credit union that—

clause.text: has total consolidated assets of less than $10,000,000,000; and
extends at least 50 percent of the loans extended by the credit union to borrowers who are low-income borrowers, as determined by the Secretary.

subparagraph.text: The term impact bank means a depository institution, as defined in section 3 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (12 U.S.C. 1813) that—

clause.text: has total consolidated assets of less than $10,000,000,000; and
extends at least 50 percent of the loans extended by the institution to borrowers who are low-income borrowers, as determined by the Secretary.

subparagraph.text: The term Program means the Community Capital Investment Program.
